label: Something is totally held: in act in a respect and held there by a sole non-reciprocal holder
paraphrase: OPEN analyst observation premise, attribution deferred: some being x is in act in some respect r and some z totally holds x in r (TotallyHeld, definition acde39ee-8d60-4ea7-a821-de96c86e5b03): z, other than x, presently actualizes x in r, nothing else does, and x does not presently actualize z in r. Physical example: a lamp hanging from a single hook. Scope: ordinary statics establishes that the hook is the only physical holder of the lamp's position; it does not establish that no non-physical co-holder exists. Under the C* support bundle (the esse instance f834ee65-53eb-4aea-b07c-42b06dbd1dfd, accident-inclusive conservation 1a99cebe-3c0a-4e32-95bc-e2e458505322 and the lackable-being bridge 6e2176cd-eeb6-413c-8fd2-7b2df4a34ad4) the giver of the lamp's being co-holds its lackable position, so the hook is then not its total holder; the premise then holds of a lackable act only with a total holder that gives being (see the argument concluding that a total holder of a lackable act gives being).
